certification_rule.name: Y1k: resynchronization-robust certification over known edges
certification_rule.definition: apply the BRUTE_PLAN_004 certification (frozen v0.1.0 gate order). If the result is CERTIFIED with code x for action b, let m be the emission mask of the latest observation (a None bit allows both values). For every surviving <=4 row p and every visited state j < p.used with masks_p[j] & m != 0: if the edge (j,b) is known, add masks_p[trans_p[j,b]] to a union U; if it is unknown and j is the row's current state, add every visited emission of p and, if p.used < 4, all four codes; if it is unknown and j is not current, skip it. The forecast stays CERTIFIED iff U == {x}; otherwise status ABSTAIN, reason RESYNC_AMBIGUOUS, certificate and public certificate None. A RESYNC_AMBIGUOUS forecast is never recorded as issued.
certification_rule.geometric_reading: Inferred: the certificate must be constant on the fibre of the version space over the latest observation (every place the hidden state could be if it had jumped unseen at the latest step), restricted to edges the data have pinned down. Residual risk (Inferred): a jump into a state whose edge for b is still unknown is not covered.
certification_rule.unchanged: no other gate changes; the margin, saturation and public-certificate rules are those of v0.2.0

experiment_rule.name: LU-R: one-step certifiability lookahead scored with the Y1k gate
experiment_rule.definition: BRUTE_PLAN_004 experiment_rule (LU) with one change: in N(a,c), the family copy's single code x for b must also pass the Y1k test computed on the family copy with m = the mask of full observation c. Tie -> default (passive) action; rounding 12 d.p.
experiment_rule.check_option: CHECK_RUN k (default 0 = off for A3): when k>0, the family and margin are supported and no alarm is set, and the LU/LU-R choice equals each of the last k taken actions, the other action is taken instead (experiment.check=True). Used only by arm E2 with k=3.

metrics.dual_coverage: policy-independent coverage: at each post-burn-in step both predict(0) and predict(1) are evaluated before acting; dual coverage = (number of certified (step, action) pairs)/(2 x steps). Each counterfactual certificate is checked against the evaluator's hidden next emission for that action (drift4: bgr90.worlds.step). predict is side-effect-free; only the taken action's forecast is recorded as issued.
metrics.on_policy_coverage: certified fraction of the taken action, reported (Inferred to overstate learning because the active policy steers into well-known regions, DISCOVERIES D2)
metrics.false_certificate: any conditional or public certificate (taken or counterfactual action) whose code differs from the evaluator truth
metrics.drift_steps: drift4 trace steps 12, 23, 34 (bgr90.worlds.step perturbs t>0, t%11==0)
metrics.stale_false_certificate: drift4 false certificate (taken or counterfactual action, conditional or public) at a non-drift step after the first drift step (step > 12, step not in {12,23,34})
metrics.check_rate: fraction of post-burn-in steps with experiment.check=True
metrics.switch_rate: fraction of post-burn-in steps whose taken action differs from the previous taken action

G14_D7_D8_single_mechanism_test.hypothesis_H: D7 and D8 are one mechanism: exploitation suppresses untaken-branch checks, which leaves stale certainty after an unannounced change. Prediction: forcing untaken-branch checks while keeping v0.2.0 certification (E2 vs A2) raises counterfactual knowledge AND lowers stale false certificates.
G14_D7_D8_single_mechanism_test.data: drift4 main block (72 cases) + extended drift4 block (216 cases) for stale counts; in_family main block for M and P1

G14_D7_D8_single_mechanism_test.decision_rule: CONFIRMED iff M and P1 hold and S(A2) >= 5 and S(E2) <= 0.5 x S(A2). FALSIFIED iff M holds, S(A2) >= 5 and S(E2) >= S(A2) (restoring checks does not reduce stale certainty, so stale certainty is not caused by the suppression of checks). Otherwise OPEN (including M failing or S(A2) < 5).
G14_D7_D8_single_mechanism_test.alternative_mechanism_report: reported, not gated: S(A3) (Y1k without checks) and check_rate(A3) — if S(A3) = 0 while check_rate(A3) = 0, stale certainty is attributed (Inferred) to certification on an unresolved fibre after an unseen jump, not to the exploration rate
